description:
Job Description: 
 
 · Monitor Cassandra clusters, performance and capacity planning 
 · Manage nodes of Datastax (Cassandra/SOLR) cluster 
 · Cassandra cluster connectivity and security 
 · Datastax Software installation and configuration 
 · Datastax Software patches and upgrades 
 · Using monitoring and management tools (e.g. DataStax OpsCenter) 
 · Troubleshoot Cassandra/SOLR 
 · Database backup and recovery 
 · Disk space management 
 · Automate manual tasks 
 · Certification as Datastaxt Administrator or Developer 
 · Experience in relational database. 
 · Strong understanding of SQL in accessing and manipulating data 
 · Strong understanding of system architecture. 
 · Strong CQLSH skills 
 · Experience with a variety of file formats (XML, JSON, unstructured data, etc.) 
 · Experience in database performance tuning required 
 · Experience in database upgrades required 
 · Experience in all aspects of the software development lifecycle including: requirements gathering, design, coding, testing and production support 
 · Understanding of Unix and Linux operating systems 
 · Advanced analytical and problem solving skills 
 Unix shell scripting 
 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
